evals.prompt: I just got a new Mac. Set up the golems ecosystem from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Checks all required CLI dependencies (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch). Installs missing ones via brew/curl. Creates skill symlinks. Wires MCP servers. Verifies 1Password access.

assertions.name: verifies-deps-before-install
assertions.description: Checks which CLIs are installed (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch) before attempting to install missing ones

assertions.name: creates-skill-symlinks
assertions.description: Symlinks skills from ~/Gits/golems/skills/golem-powers/ into ~/.claude/commands/ and verifies count (40+)

assertions.name: wires-mcp-servers
assertions.description: Checks for brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp binaries and provides bun link instructions if missing

assertions.name: runs-validation-checklist
assertions.description: Runs the validation checklist at the end to confirm CLIs, skills count, and MCP binaries are all working

evals.prompt: My Claude skills aren't showing up. I think something went wrong with the setup.
evals.expected_output: Checks ~/.claude/commands/ for existing symlinks. Re-runs the symlink creation step from golem-powers. Verifies the skill count is 40+.

assertions.name: checks-existing-symlinks
assertions.description: Lists ~/.claude/commands/ to see current state before re-creating symlinks

assertions.name: verifies-skill-count
assertions.description: Counts linked skills and verifies there are 40+ (not just 'done' without checking)

evals.prompt: I need to verify my golem setup is correct. Run the full validation.
evals.expected_output: Runs the validation checklist: checks all 7 CLIs (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch), counts skills in ~/.claude/commands/, checks brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp binaries.

assertions.name: checks-all-seven-clis
assertions.description: Checks all required CLIs: gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch (not a subset)

assertions.name: checks-mcp-binaries
assertions.description: Verifies brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp are in PATH

assertions.name: reports-specific-failures
assertions.description: Reports which specific items passed/failed with clear indicators, not just a blanket pass/fail
